Explore CROBOT at /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/CROBOT to understand all navigation issues and how admin panel access works.

1. Read `src/App.tsx` fully — understand ALL routes, especially admin routes and how they're structured
2. Read `src/components/AdminLayout.tsx` fully — understand the admin sidebar, does it have a Dashboard link?
3. Read `src/components/AdminRoute.tsx` fully — understand the guard
4. Read `src/components/TopBar.tsx` fully — look at the user dropdown menu. Is there an "Admin Panel" link for admin users?
5. Read `src/components/AppSidebar.tsx` fully — is there an admin link in the user sidebar?
6. Read `src/pages/admin/AdminDashboard.tsx` fully — does it exist and render properly?
7. Read `src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx` — check how profile.role is exposed

Also check Rankora for comparison:
8. Check if /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Rankora exists, and if so read its TopBar or similar component to see how admin panel access is handled there.

Report:
- All navigation issues (broken links, missing links, wrong routes)
- Is there an "Admin Panel" option in the TopBar dropdown for admin users?
- Does AdminLayout sidebar have a "Dashboard" item?
- Is there a way to navigate FROM the admin panel BACK to the main app?
- Any dead links or routing mismatches between sidebar items and actual routes
